chunks: All praise is to God, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and to Him belongs the praise in the Hereafter. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.

key_terms.الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ: All praise is due to God

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's ownership of the heavens and the earth?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Saba (34:1) establishes the foundation of Tawhid by affirming Allah's exclusive ownership of the cosmos and the continuity of praise into the Hereafter. In Shia exegesis, this is often linked to the concept of 'Alam al-Mithal', where the divine attributes of Wisdom (Hakim) and Knowledge (Khbir) govern both the visible and unseen realms, underscoring the ultimate return to the Creator.
